core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aqif corresponds to the Arabic form عاكف and is glossed in this record as “One who stays in devotion, worshipper.” The record associates the form with root ع ك ف (ʿ-k-f). The record identifies the form as an active participle. The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: One who stays in devotion, worshipper
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aqif corresponds to the Arabic form عاكف (Arabic root ع ك ف (ʿ-k-f); عَاكِف (ʿākif)). Its core sense is one who stays in devotion; worshipper. Aqif is Arabic عَاكِف (ʿākif) 'One who stays in devotion, worshipper', the active participle of عَكَفَ (ʿakafa, 'to devote oneself, to remain in worship') from the root ع ك ف (ʿ-k-f). Aqif is a variant romanization of Akif.

urdu.name: عاکف
urdu.long_meaning: Aqif (عاکف) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم اعتکاف کرنے والا، عبادت گزار ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: عاكف
persian.long_meaning: Aqif (عاكف) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن معتکف، عبادت گزار است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
